description:
User directed 2026-11-19: "add the elixir parity issues as tickets to the epic we gave to Elixir Parity". Owner: Elixir Parity. Found by Elixir Parity during fz-mue.15. Elixir's tokenizer drops the line end before ->, so catch
 v -> v
 -> 0
end is a syntax error in Elixir; fz reads '-> 0' as a zero-head clause, pinned by frontdoor_test compiler2_frontdoor_catch_clauses_take_one_or_more_heads_and_a_trailing_guard. Open decision for the user, before building: match Elixir, or record the zero-head form as an intended fz extension.
title: A line that begins with -> continues the line before, as in Elixir
